fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: UTC timestamp representing when the event occurred.
fields.justification: This field is required to sort events chronologically and correlate activity across different sources.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Hostname of the system associated with the event.
fields.justification: This field identifies the asset involved so analysts can correlate activity to a specific system.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Normalized type of telemetry source that produced the event.
fields.justification: This field allows analysts and detection rules to filter events by their original telemetry class.

fields.name: source_origin
fields.description: Origin of the event such as evidence_pack or student_telemetry.
fields.justification: This field distinguishes supplied evidence from telemetry added by the student.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: Normalized high-level category such as authentication, process, network, file, PowerShell, or audit.
fields.justification: This field lets downstream detections group semantically similar events without depending on vendor-specific identifiers.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Source-specific identifier associated with the event.
fields.justification: This field preserves identifiers such as Windows Event IDs and Suricata signature IDs for precise detection logic.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized severity assigned to the event.
fields.justification: This field supports prioritization and filtering during detection and triage.

fields.name: user
fields.description: User account associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: This field supports investigation of authentication activity and actions performed by specific accounts.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Name or executable path of the process associated with the event.
fields.justification: This field is needed to detect suspicious execution and correlate process-related activity.

fields.name: process_id
fields.description: Process identifier associated with the event.
fields.justification: This field allows events generated by the same running process to be correlated.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IP address associated with the event.
fields.justification: This field identifies the origin of network activity and supports connection and attacker tracing.

fields.name: src_port
fields.description: Source port associated with a network connection.
fields.justification: This field helps distinguish individual network sessions and connection endpoints.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IP address associated with the event.
fields.justification: This field identifies the destination system involved in network communication.

fields.name: dst_port
fields.description: Destination port associated with the event.
fields.justification: This field identifies the destination service involved in network communication.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Network or application protocol associated with the event.
fields.justification: This field allows analysts to distinguish traffic such as TCP, UDP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Original event message retained from the source.
fields.justification: This field preserves evidence fidelity and allows analysts to inspect information not represented in normalized fields.

fields.name: source_fields
fields.description: Source-specific structured data retained from the original event.
fields.justification: This field prevents useful vendor-specific details from being lost during normalization.
